# Load required library
library(Seurat)

# Read 10X data from current directory
# gene.column=2 uses HGNC symbols instead of Ensembl IDs
pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".", gene.column = 2)

# Create Seurat object with initial filtering
# min.cells = 3: include genes detected in at least 3 cells
# min.features = 200: include cells with at least 200 detected genes
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data, project = "pbmc2700", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial QC metrics
# pattern "^MT-" matches human mitochondrial genes
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
# Keep cells with 200-2500 genes and <5% mitochondrial content
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data using log-normalization
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Identify highly variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data on variable features
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Find neighbors and clusters
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Save final Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_final.rds")

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Load 10X data
pbmc_data <- Read10X(data.dir = ".")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc_data, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# QC filtering
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalization
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Differential expression analysis between cluster 0 and cluster 3
cluster0_vs_3_markers <- FindMarkers(pbmc, ident.1 = 0, ident.2 = 3, only.pos = FALSE)

# Prepare data for volcano plot
volcano_data <- cluster0_vs_3_markers
volcano_data$gene <- rownames(volcano_data)
volcano_data$significant <- ifelse(abs(volcano_data$avg_log2FC) > 1 & volcano_data$p_val_adj < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant")

# Create volcano plot
ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "red", "Not Significant" = "grey")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change", 
       y = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
       title = "Volcano Plot: Cluster 0 vs Cluster 3",
       color = "Significance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

pbmc.data <- Read10X(data.dir = "path/to/your/directory/")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = pbmc.data,

                          min.cells = 3,      # Filter genes detected in < 3 cells
                          min.features = 200) # Filter cells with < 200 genes

# View the object
pbmc

# Load required libraries
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Set working directory (adjust as needed)
# setwd("path/to/your/data")

# ===== 1. Load the data =====
cat("Loading data...\n")

# Read the sparse matrix
matrix_data <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes (cell IDs)
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(barcodes) <- "barcode"

# Read genes
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t")
colnames(genes) <- c("gene_id", "gene_symbol")

# Assign row and column names to the matrix
rownames(matrix_data) <- genes$gene_symbol
colnames(matrix_data) <- barcodes$barcode

cat("Data loaded successfully!\n")
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(matrix_data), "genes x", ncol(matrix_data), "cells\n\n")

# ===== 2. Calculate QC metrics =====
cat("Calculating QC metrics...\n")

# Number of UMIs (counts) per cell
umi_per_cell <- Matrix::colSums(matrix_data)

# Number of detected genes per cell (genes with count > 0)
genes_per_cell <- Matrix::colSums(matrix_data > 0)

# Identify mitochondrial genes (genes starting with "MT-" or "mt-")
mito_genes <- grep("^MT-|^mt-", rownames(matrix_data), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
cat("Found", length(mito_genes), "mitochondrial genes\n")

# Calculate percentage of mitochondrial gene expression per cell
if (length(mito_genes) > 0) {
  mito_counts <- Matrix::colSums(matrix_data[mito_genes, , drop = FALSE])
  percent_mito <- (mito_counts / umi_per_cell) * 100
} else {
  percent_mito <- rep(0, ncol(matrix_data))
  cat("Warning: No mitochondrial genes found!\n")
}

# Create QC dataframe
qc_metrics <- data.frame(
  barcode = barcodes$barcode,
  n_umi = umi_per_cell,
  n_genes = genes_per_cell,
  percent_mito = percent_mito
)

# ===== 3. Visualize QC metrics (before filtering) =====
cat("\nGenerating QC plots...\n")

# Plot 1: UMI counts per cell
p1 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_umi)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 500, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "UMI Counts per Cell", x = "Total UMI counts", y = "Number of cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 2: Genes detected per cell
p2 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_genes)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "darkgreen", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 200, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Genes Detected per Cell", x = "Number of genes", y = "Number of cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 3: Mitochondrial percentage
p3 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = percent_mito)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "coral", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Mitochondrial Gene Percentage", x = "% Mitochondrial genes", y = "Number of cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 4: Scatter plot - genes vs UMIs
p4 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_umi, y = n_genes, color = percent_mito)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  labs(title = "Genes vs UMIs", x = "Total UMI counts", y = "Number of genes detected",
       color = "% Mito") +
  theme_minimal()

# Save plots
ggsave("qc_umi_distribution.png", p1, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_genes_distribution.png", p2, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_mito_distribution.png", p3, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_genes_vs_umi.png", p4, width = 8, height = 6)

# ===== 4. Print summary statistics =====
cat("\n===== QC Summary Statistics (Before Filtering) =====\n")
cat("Total cells:", nrow(qc_metrics), "\n")
cat("\nUMI counts per cell:\n")
print(summary(qc_metrics$n_umi))
cat("\nGenes detected per cell:\n")
print(summary(qc_metrics$n_genes))
cat("\nMitochondrial percentage:\n")
print(summary(qc_metrics$percent_mito))

# ===== 5. Define filtering thresholds =====
cat("\n===== Applying Quality Control Filters =====\n")

# Standard filtering thresholds (adjust based on your data)
min_genes <- 200        # Minimum genes detected per cell
max_genes <- 5000       # Maximum genes (to remove potential doublets)
min_umi <- 500          # Minimum UMI counts per cell
max_mito <- 10          # Maximum mitochondrial percentage

cat("Filtering criteria:\n")
cat("  - Minimum genes per cell:", min_genes, "\n")
cat("  - Maximum genes per cell:", max_genes, "\n")
cat("  - Minimum UMI counts:", min_umi, "\n")
cat("  - Maximum mitochondrial %:", max_mito, "\n\n")

# ===== 6. Filter cells =====
cells_to_keep <- qc_metrics$n_genes >= min_genes &
                 qc_metrics$n_genes <= max_genes &
                 qc_metrics$n_umi >= min_umi &
                 qc_metrics$percent_mito <= max_mito

cat("Cells before filtering:", sum(!cells_to_keep) + sum(cells_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Cells passing QC:", sum(cells_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Cells removed:", sum(!cells_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Percentage retained:", round(100 * sum(cells_to_keep) / length(cells_to_keep), 2), "%\n\n")

# Filter the matrix and QC metrics
filtered_matrix <- matrix_data[, cells_to_keep]
filtered_qc <- qc_metrics[cells_to_keep, ]

# ===== 7. Filter genes (optional: remove genes not expressed in any cell) =====
genes_to_keep <- Matrix::rowSums(filtered_matrix) > 0
filtered_matrix <- filtered_matrix[genes_to_keep, ]

cat("Genes before filtering:", nrow(matrix_data), "\n")
cat("Genes after filtering:", nrow(filtered_matrix), "\n")
cat("Genes removed:", sum(!genes_to_keep), "\n\n")

# ===== 8. Save filtered data =====
cat("Saving filtered data...\n")

# Save filtered matrix
writeMM(filtered_matrix, "filtered_matrix.mtx")

# Save filtered barcodes
write.table(filtered_qc$barcode, "filtered_barcodes.tsv", 
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE)

# Save filtered genes
filtered_genes <- genes[genes_to_keep, ]
write.table(filtered_genes, "filtered_genes.tsv", 
            quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")

# Save QC metrics
write.csv(qc_metrics, "qc_metrics_all_cells.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(filtered_qc, "qc_metrics_filtered_cells.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Quality Control Complete! =====\n")
cat("Filtered data saved to:\n")
cat("  - filtered_matrix.mtx\n")
cat("  - filtered_barcodes.tsv\n")
cat("  - filtered_genes.tsv\n")
cat("  - qc_metrics_all_cells.csv\n")
cat("  - qc_metrics_filtered_cells.csv\n")
cat("  - QC plots (PNG files)\n")

# ===== 9. Return results =====
results <- list(
  original_matrix = matrix_data,
  filtered_matrix = filtered_matrix,
  qc_metrics = qc_metrics,
  filtered_qc = filtered_qc,
  filtering_summary = data.frame(
    metric = c("Total cells", "Cells passing QC", "Cells removed", "Retention rate"),
    value = c(ncol(matrix_data), ncol(filtered_matrix), 
              ncol(matrix_data) - ncol(filtered_matrix),
              paste0(round(100 * ncol(filtered_matrix) / ncol(matrix_data), 2), "%"))
  )
)

print(results$filtering_summary)

# Single-cell RNA-seq Analysis Pipeline for 2,700 PBMCs
# Required package: Seurat

# Install Seurat if not already installed
if (!require("Seurat", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("Seurat")
}

library(Seurat)

# ============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ============================================================================

# Read the Matrix Market format data
# Assumes files are in current working directory
pbmc_data <- ReadMtx(
  mtx = "matrix.mtx",
  cells = "barcodes.tsv",
  features = "genes.tsv",
  feature.column = 2  # Use HGNC symbols (column 2) as feature names
)

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = pbmc_data,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,      # Include features detected in at least 3 cells
  min.features = 200  # Include cells with at least 200 detected features
)

cat("Loaded data dimensions:", dim(pbmc), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 2. QUALITY CONTROL (Optional but recommended)
# ============================================================================

# Calculate mitochondrial QC metrics
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

cat("After QC filtering:", dim(pbmc), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 3. NORMALIZATION
# ============================================================================

# Log-normalize the data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(
  pbmc,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000
)

cat("✓ Data normalized\n")

# ============================================================================
# 4. IDENTIFY HIGHLY VARIABLE FEATURES
# ============================================================================

# Find top 2000 highly variable genes
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(
  pbmc,
  selection.method = "vst",
  nfeatures = 2000
)

# Identify the 10 most highly variable genes
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(pbmc), 10)
cat("Top 10 variable features:", paste(top10, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Plot variable features
plot1 <- VariableFeaturePlot(pbmc)
plot2 <- LabelPoints(plot = plot1, points = top10, repel = TRUE)
print(plot2)

# ============================================================================
# 5. SCALE THE DATA
# ============================================================================

# Scale all genes
all_genes <- rownames(pbmc)
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = all_genes)

cat("✓ Data scaled\n")

# ============================================================================
# 6. RUN PCA
# ============================================================================

# Perform linear dimensional reduction
pbmc <- RunPCA(
  pbmc,
  features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc),
  npcs = 50
)

# Visualize PCA results
print(pbmc[["pca"]], dims = 1:5, nfeatures = 5)
VizDimLoadings(pbmc, dims = 1:2, reduction = "pca")
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca")

# Elbow plot to determine dimensionality
ElbowPlot(pbmc, ndims = 50)

cat("✓ PCA completed\n")

# ============================================================================
# 7. CLUSTERING
# ============================================================================

# Determine the dimensionality (using first 20 PCs based on typical PBMC data)
dims_use <- 1:20

# Find neighbors
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = dims_use)

# Find clusters (resolution 0.5 is good for ~3K cells)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Check number of clusters
cat("Number of clusters identified:", length(levels(pbmc@active.ident)), "\n")
cat("Cluster sizes:\n")
print(table(Idents(pbmc)))

# ============================================================================
# 8. RUN UMAP
# ============================================================================

# Run UMAP for visualization
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = dims_use)

cat("✓ UMAP completed\n")

# ============================================================================
# 9. VISUALIZE CLUSTERS
# ============================================================================

# UMAP plot colored by cluster
p1 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 6) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters (UMAP)")
print(p1)

# UMAP plot with cluster labels
p2 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, label.size = 4, repel = TRUE) +
  NoLegend() +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters with Labels")
print(p2)

# PCA plot colored by cluster
p3 <- DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "pca", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("PBMC Clusters (PCA)")
print(p3)

# ============================================================================
# 10. FIND CLUSTER MARKERS (Optional)
# ============================================================================

# Find markers for all clusters
pbmc_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  pbmc,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

# Display top markers per cluster
top5_markers <- pbmc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC)

print(top5_markers)

# Visualize top marker genes
top_genes <- top5_markers$gene[1:9]  # Top 9 genes for visualization
FeaturePlot(pbmc, features = top_genes, ncol = 3)

# Heatmap of top markers
top10_markers <- pbmc_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  top_n(n = 10, wt = avg_log2FC)

DoHeatmap(pbmc, features = top10_markers$gene) + NoLegend()

# ============================================================================
# 11. SAVE RESULTS
# ============================================================================

# Save the Seurat object
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_analysis.rds")

# Save cluster assignments
write.csv(
  data.frame(
    barcode = colnames(pbmc),
    cluster = Idents(pbmc)
  ),
  file = "cluster_assignments.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save marker genes
write.csv(pbmc_markers, file = "cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n✓ Analysis complete! Results saved.\n")
cat("Seurat object: pbmc_analysis.rds\n")
cat("Cluster assignments: cluster_assignments.csv\n")
cat("Marker genes: cluster_markers.csv\n")

# ============================================================================
# SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total cells analyzed:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Total genes:", nrow(pbmc), "\n")
cat("Number of clusters:", length(levels(Idents(pbmc))), "\n")
cat("PCs used for clustering:", paste(dims_use, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Clustering resolution:", 0.5, "\n")

# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================================
# 1. Load the 10X-style data files
# ============================================================================

# Read the sparse matrix (Matrix Market format)
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes (cell identifiers)
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(barcodes) <- "barcode"

# Read genes (gene IDs and symbols)
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(genes) <- c("gene_id", "gene_symbol")

# Assign row and column names to the matrix
rownames(matrix) <- genes$gene_symbol
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$barcode

# ============================================================================
# 2. Create Seurat object
# ============================================================================

pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = matrix,
  project = "PBMC2700",
  min.cells = 3,      # Keep genes expressed in at least 3 cells
  min.features = 200  # Keep cells with at least 200 genes
)

# ============================================================================
# 3. Quality Control (QC) filtering
# ============================================================================

# Calculate mitochondrial percentage
pbmc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(pbmc, pattern = "^MT-")

# Visualize QC metrics
VlnPlot(pbmc, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3)

# Filter cells based on QC metrics
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

cat("Cells after QC filtering:", ncol(pbmc), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 4. Normalization

genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create a Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, project = "PBMC", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
pbmc@colnames <- barcodes$V1
pbmc@rownames <- genes$V1

# Normalize the data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Identify highly variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale the data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Perform clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Compute UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Visualize the clusters
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap")

pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Load necessary libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, rownames = genes[, 2], colnames = barcodes[, 1])

# Filter cells and genes
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
pbmc <- JackStraw(pbmc, num.replicate = 100)
pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Run clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Define marker genes for each cell type
marker_genes <- list(
  "CD4 T cells" = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD14 Monocytes" = c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  "B cells" = c("MS4A1"),
  "CD8 T cells" = c("CD8A"),
  "NK cells" = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

# Annotate clusters with cell type labels
cell_types <- rep(NA, nrow(pbmc@meta.data))
for (i in 1:ncol(pbmc@meta.data)) {
  cluster <- colnames(pbmc@meta.data)[i]
  for (cell_type in names(marker_genes)) {
    markers <- marker_genes[[cell_type]]
    avg_expr <- rowMeans(pbmc@assays$RNA@data[markers, pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters == i])
    if (mean(avg_expr) > 0.5) {
      cell_types[pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters == i] <- cell_type
    }
  }
}

# Add cell type labels to Seurat object
pbmc@meta.data$cell_type <- cell_types

# Visualize UMAP with cell type labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type")

# Load necessary libraries
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, project = "PBMC", genes = genes[, 2], cells = barcodes[, 1])

# Filter cells and genes
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = rownames(pbmc))

# Perform PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
elbow <- InflectionPoint(pbmc@reductions$pca@stddev)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)

# Cluster cells
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Perform differential expression analysis
cluster0 <- subset(pbmc, idents = "0")
cluster3 <- subset(pbmc, idents = "3")
diff <- FindMarkers(cluster0, cluster3, only.pos = FALSE)

# Create volcano plot
volcano_data <- data.frame(log2FC = diff$avg_logFC, p_val_adj = diff$p_val_adj)
volcano_data$significant <- ifelse(abs(volcano_data$log2FC) > 1 & volcano_data$p_val_adj < 0.05, "yes", "no")

ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 Adjusted p-value")
